title: Why consistency beats virality for small brands

scenes.narration: The post that changes your business probably won't be your most viral one.
scenes.caption: Viral isn't the goal

scenes.narration: Consistency creates recognition before it creates reach.
scenes.caption: Consistency creates recognition

scenes.narration: A repeatable message compounds over time.
scenes.caption: Your message compounds

scenes.narration: Build one useful idea into a weekly series.
scenes.caption: One idea. Every week.

scenes.narration: Virality is a spike. Trust is a system.
scenes.caption: Build trust, not spikes
